name: tynt
description: A tiny browser game console for making and sharing monochrome TypeScript games.
author: Cristian Granda (https://cristianbgp.com)

scripts.install:all: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd packages/core --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd apps/web --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd apps/docs --frozen-lockfile
scripts.dev:web: bun run cartridges:generate && bun run --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.format: bun run --cwd apps/web format && bun run --cwd apps/docs format
scripts.format:check: bun run --cwd apps/web format:check && bun run --cwd apps/docs format:check
scripts.test: bun run cartridges:generate && bun test scripts/cartridges/tests scripts/repository/tests && bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.build: bun run cartridges:generate && bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run docs:build
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run cartridges:check && bun run test && bun run test:e2e && bun run build
